description: This file provides utility functions for handling stack traces, including capturing, parsing, rewriting error messages, and converting stack frames to strings. It defines types for raw stacks and stack frames, and includes functions for parsing stack traces, extracting error messages, and handling file URLs.

methods.name: captureRawStack
methods.description: Captures the current call stack as an array of strings, temporarily setting the Error.stackTraceLimit to 50.

methods.name: parseStackFrame
methods.description: Parses a single line of a stack trace into a StackFrame object, extracting file, line, column, and function name.

methods.name: rewriteErrorMessage
methods.description: Rewrites an Error object's message and stack trace with a new message.

methods.name: stringifyStackFrames
methods.description: Converts an array of StackFrame objects into an array of formatted stack trace lines.

methods.name: splitErrorMessage
methods.description: Splits an error message into its name and message components.

methods.name: parseErrorStack
methods.description: Parses a full error stack string into its message, stack lines, and the first relevant location.
